answer_1.quote: We introduce a Performance Prediction task for Text Summarization under Domain Shift and Instruct-Tuning.

answer_2.quote: We include BERTScore Precision, BERTScore Recall, and BERTScore F1 score.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o-mini as a judge to do a prompt-based evaluation of all generated summaries against Coherence, Readability, Relevance, and Fluency.

answer_4.quote: We recruited eight annotators from a local university and compensated them at 16 euros per hour.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was asked to assign a score between -1 and +1, reflecting the quality of a summary relative to a provided reference.
criteria: quality of a summary relative to a provided reference
